name: io.github.skyhook-io/radar
title: Radar Kubernetes MCP Server
description: Kubernetes MCP server for diagnosis, resource management, GitOps, and RBAC-enforced operations.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Expose Radar's HTTP server (UI + MCP) on 127.0.0.1:9280 only

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount your kubeconfig into the container (read-only)

kubeconfig_path.description: Absolute path to your kubeconfig file on the host, e.g. /home/you/.kube/config (a leading ~ is not expanded when the client execs docker directly)

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Point Radar at the mounted kubeconfig
